title: 验证卷 #8 · a number of（裸用）主谓一致·纯填空
topic: IELTS 话题语境变式（第八轮·只考'裸 a number of → 复数谓语'，不叠加被动/完成时）
goal: 上轮填空崩在'主谓一致+时态+语态'三件事同时产出。本轮把干扰项拆掉：3 道填空只用 be / 简单现在或过去时，逼你只判断单复数；2 道选择做 the/a-large 对照锚点。全对即过关。

questions.prompt: A number of students in this school ____ (be) interested in studying abroad.
questions.explanation: 裸 a number of = many + 复数名词 → are。主语核心是后面的复数名词，不是 number。

questions.prompt: A number of new apps ____ (appear) on the market every year to help students study.
questions.explanation: 裸 a number of + 复数名词 → 复数；every year → 一般现在时，动词用原形 appear（不是 appears）。

questions.prompt: A number of complaints about road noise ____ (come) in from nearby residents last week.
questions.explanation: 裸 a number of + 复数名词 → 复数；last week → 一般过去时 came。

questions.prompt: The number of applications received by the university ____ steadily over the past decade.
questions.explanation: the number of → 主语核心是'那个数字'→ has。对照锚点：和裸 a number of（→ have）只差一个冠词，规则相反。

questions.prompt: A large number of the graduates who finished last year ____ now working abroad.
questions.explanation: a large number of + 复数名词 → are。'of...'后的名词才是主语核心，仍是复数。
